llms.body:
# Formstack

> Formstack (now part of Intellistack) is a workplace productivity suite that helps over 32,000 organizations digitize what matters, automate workflows, and fix processes—without code. The platform combines secure online forms, automated document generation, and eSignatures into a single suite, with deep Salesforce-native capabilities and 100+ integrations to CRMs, payment processors, cloud storage, and marketing tools.

Formstack's core value proposition is connecting data capture, document creation, and signature collection into unified workflows. Customers save an average of 17 hours per week by replacing paper processes, manual data entry, and disconnected point tools with Formstack's no-code suite. The product is sold both as standalone tools (Forms, Documents, Sign) and as a bundled Suite, with specialized Salesforce-native editions (Forms for Salesforce, Documents for Salesforce) and white-label/embedded options for ISVs. For broader AI-native process automation and contract lifecycle management, Formstack directs users to its parent platform, Intellistack Streamline.

## Products

- [Forms](https://www.formstack.com/products/online-forms): Enterprise-grade, no-code online form builder with AI-assisted form creation
- [Documents](https://www.formstack.com/products/documents): Automated document generation that turns form data into dynamic, branded documents
- [Sign](https://www.formstack.com/products/sign): Drag-and-drop eSignature solution for collecting legally binding digital signatures on any device
- [Suite](https://www.formstack.com/products/suite): All-in-one bundle combining Forms, Documents, Sign, and Workflows
- [Forms for Salesforce](https://www.formstack.com/products/forms-for-salesforce): Native Salesforce forms that collect and manage data within the Salesforce org
- [Documents for Salesforce](https://www.formstack.com/products/documents-for-salesforce): Salesforce-integrated document generation for proposals, contracts, and invoices
- [Formstack for Salesforce](https://www.formstack.com/products/formstack-for-salesforce): Unified Salesforce workflow automation with forms, docs, and signatures
- [Formstack for Software (ISV)](https://www.formstack.com/isv-partner): White-label and embedded forms, doc gen, and eSignature for software vendors
- [Pricing](https://www.formstack.com/pricing): Product plans and tier comparisons

## Solutions by Industry

- [Healthcare](https://www.formstack.com/industry/healthcare): HIPAA-compliant forms, patient onboarding, and healthcare marketing
- [Patient Onboarding](https://www.formstack.com/solutions/patient-onboarding): Streamlined digital intake for healthcare providers
- [HIPAA Data Security](https://www.formstack.com/solutions/hipaa-data-security): HIPAA compliance features and practices
- [Healthcare Marketing](https://www.formstack.com/solutions/healthcare-marketing): Lead generation and patient engagement
- [Financial Services](https://www.formstack.com/industry/financial-services): Claims, reports, and compliant data capture for financial firms
- [Claims & Reports](https://www.formstack.com/solutions/claims-reports): Automated claims intake and reporting workflows
- [Salesforce Financial Services Automation](https://www.formstack.com/solutions/salesforce-financial-services-automation): Salesforce-native automation for financial teams
- [eSignatures for Insurance](https://www.formstack.com/solutions/electronic-signature-for-insurance): Digital signature workflows for insurance
- [Higher Education](https://www.formstack.com/industry/higher-education): Digital forms and workflows for universities
- [Student Engagement](https://www.formstack.com/solutions/student-engagement): Student-facing forms and processes
- [Prospective Students](https://www.formstack.com/solutions/prospective-students): Admissions and recruitment workflows
- [Alumni Experiences](https://www.formstack.com/solutions/alumni): Alumni engagement forms and surveys
- [Software & Technology](https://www.formstack.com/industry/software): Forms and workflows for SaaS companies
- [Employee Onboarding](https://www.formstack.com/solutions/employee-onboarding): Digital HR onboarding workflows
- [Lead Generation](https://www.formstack.com/use-case/lead-generation): Marketing lead capture forms
- [Customer Satisfaction Surveys](https://www.formstack.com/solutions/customer-satisfaction-surveys): Feedback and CSAT surveys

## Solutions by Role

- [Salesforce Admins](https://www.formstack.com/roles/salesforce-admins): Salesforce-native tools for admins
- [Finance](https://www.formstack.com/roles/finance): Finance team forms and automation
- [Marketing & Sales](https://www.formstack.com/roles/sales-and-marketing): Marketing lead capture and sales workflows
- [Human Resources](https://www.formstack.com/roles/human-resources): HR onboarding and employee processes
- [IT](https://www.formstack.com/roles/it): IT request and ticketing workflows
- [Security & Compliance](https://www.formstack.com/roles/security-and-compliance): Security and compliance-focused use cases

## Integrations

- [All integrations](https://www.formstack.com/integrations): 100+ integrations across CRMs, payments, storage, and more
- [Salesforce](https://www.formstack.com/integrations/salesforce): Deep Salesforce integration across Forms, Documents, and Sign
- [HubSpot](https://www.formstack.com/integrations/hubspot): HubSpot CRM integration
- [Microsoft Dynamics](https://www.formstack.com/integrations/dynamics): Dynamics 365 integration
- [Amazon S3](https://www.formstack.com/integrations/amazon-s3-storage): File storage integration
- [Stripe](https://www.formstack.com/integrations/stripe): Payment processing
- [PayPal](https://www.formstack.com/integrations/paypal): Payment processing

## Resources

- [Resource Center](https://www.formstack.com/resources): Blog, guides, templates, and customer stories
- [Templates](https://www.formstack.com/templates): Pre-built form and workflow templates
- [Blog](https://www.formstack.com/blogs): Articles on automation, productivity, and industry topics
- [Customer Stories](https://www.formstack.com/customer-stories): Case studies and success stories
- [Release Notes](https://roadmap.formstack.com/tabs/31-release-notes): Product updates and changelog
- [Site Map](https://www.formstack.com/sitemap): Full site navigation
- [Events & Webinars](https://www.intellistack.com/resources/events): Live sessions and recorded webinars

## Support & Documentation

- [Help Center](https://help.formstack.com/): Knowledge base and support tickets
- [System Status](https://www.formstackstatus.com/): Real-time platform status
- [Formstack Academy](https://academy.intellistack.com/pages/training-library): Courses, tutorials, and quick-start guides
- [Report Abuse](https://www.formstack.com/report-abuse): Report forms that violate terms

## Developers

- [Developers & API reference](https://developers.formstack.com/reference/api-overview): REST API documentation
- [Formstack Documents API](https://www.webmerge.me/developers): Documents-specific API (WebMerge legacy)

## Partners

- [Partners overview](https://www.formstack.com/partners): Join the certified partner program
- [Find a Partner](https://www.formstack.com/find-a-partner): Directory of implementation partners
- [ISV / Software partners](https://www.formstack.com/isv-partner): Embed Formstack in your software product

## Sales & Signup

- [Talk to Sales](https://www.formstack.com/contact-sales): Contact the sales team
- [Sign In](https://admin.formstack.com/login): Customer login
- [Start a free 14-day trial](https://admin.formstack.com/signup/formstack-2024-suite?periodicity=monthly): Trial signup for the Formstack Suite

## Company & Legal

- [About (via Intellistack)](https://www.intellistack.com/about): Company story and mission
- [Careers (via Intellistack)](https://www.intellistack.com/careers): Open roles
- [Security (via Intellistack)](https://www.intellistack.com/security): Security practices
- [Trust Center](https://trust.intellistack.com): Compliance and trust documentation
- [Legal](https://www.intellistack.com/legal): Legal terms
- [CCPA](https://www.intellistack.com/ccpa): California privacy rights

## Related: Intellistack (Parent Platform)

- [Intellistack Streamline](https://www.intellistack.com): Market-first process automation platform for AI-native, no-code workflows
- [Intellistack CLM](https://www.intellistack.com/platform/clm): Contract lifecycle management (for users needing more than docs + eSign)
